template.name: Record-to-Report (Financial Close)
template.description: Period-end close, manual journal entries, account reconciliations, estimates and judgements, consolidation, financial statement preparation and disclosure review. Includes entity-level controls over financial reporting oversight.

risks.title: Manual journal entries are posted without authorization or support, including top-side entries used to manipulate results (management override of controls).
Balance sheet accounts are not reconciled or reconciling items are not investigated, so errors and misappropriation go undetected.
Period-end close tasks are omitted or performed out of sequence, resulting in incomplete or inaccurate financial data.
Accounting estimates (provisions, impairment, useful lives, ECL, zakat and tax) are based on unsupported assumptions or are not reviewed by management.
Intercompany balances and transactions do not eliminate, or consolidation entries are incorrect, misstating group financial statements.
Financial statements and disclosures do not comply with IFRS as endorsed in the KSA (SOCPA) or CMA reporting requirements, or contain errors not detected before issuance.
New or unusual transactions and changes in accounting standards are not identified and assessed, leading to inappropriate accounting treatment.

controls.title: Manual journal entry approval workflow
controls.description: All manual journal entries are prepared with a description and supporting documentation attached in the ERP and routed by workflow to an approver independent of the preparer: Financial Controller for entries up to SAR 500,000 and CFO above that threshold. The system prevents posting without approval and prevents the preparer from approving their own entry.

controls.title: Post-close journal entry review for management override
controls.description: After each period close, Internal Audit or the Financial Reporting Manager runs a journal entry analytic on all manual entries (posted by senior finance staff, posted outside business hours, round amounts, entries to revenue or reserves, entries with vague descriptions, entries posted after period end into the closed period) and reviews the selected entries to support, documenting conclusions.

controls.title: Balance sheet account reconciliation and review
controls.description: All balance sheet accounts are assigned an owner and risk rating in the reconciliation tool; high-risk accounts (cash, receivables, payables, inventory, fixed assets, accruals, intercompany) are reconciled monthly and lower-risk accounts quarterly. Each reconciliation agrees the GL balance to independent supporting documentation, explains and ages reconciling items, and is reviewed and signed by a reviewer one level above the preparer within 10 working days of period end. Items over 90 days are escalated to the Financial Controller.

controls.title: Financial close checklist and timetable
controls.description: The month-end close is governed by a standard close checklist listing every task (sub-ledger close, accruals, depreciation run, FX revaluation, allocations, reconciliations, flux analysis), owner and due day. Task completion is signed off by the task owner and the checklist is reviewed by the Financial Controller before the ledger is closed for the period.

controls.title: Monthly flux (variance) analysis
controls.description: The Financial Reporting team prepares an analysis of the income statement and balance sheet comparing the current month to prior month, budget and prior year; variances above 10% and SAR 250,000 are explained with reference to business drivers. The CFO reviews the flux analysis and challenges explanations in the monthly close review meeting; minutes evidence the review.

controls.title: Accounting estimates and judgements review
controls.description: Each significant estimate (ECL, inventory obsolescence, provisions and contingencies, asset impairment, useful lives, zakat/tax provision, employee end-of-service benefits) is supported by a position paper documenting methodology, data inputs, key assumptions and sensitivity, prepared quarterly and reviewed and approved by the CFO. Actuarial and valuation specialist reports are reviewed for consistency with the entity's data.

controls.title: Intercompany reconciliation and elimination
controls.description: Intercompany balances and transactions are matched between counterparties monthly in the intercompany module; mismatches are resolved before the ledger is closed and any unresolved difference above SAR 50,000 is escalated to the Group Financial Controller. Consolidation eliminations are generated by the consolidation system and the elimination report is reviewed for completeness.

controls.title: Consolidation package review
controls.description: Subsidiary reporting packages are validated by the consolidation system (balanced trial balance, mapping to group chart of accounts, movement schedules agree) and the Group Reporting Manager reviews each package for completeness and unusual items before consolidation. Consolidation adjustments (fair value, NCI, FX translation) are reviewed by the Group Financial Controller.

controls.title: Financial statement disclosure checklist and review
controls.description: Interim and annual financial statements are prepared using a lead schedule tie-out to the trial balance and a current IFRS (as endorsed in KSA by SOCPA) disclosure checklist completed by Financial Reporting and reviewed by the Financial Controller. The CFO reviews the draft financial statements, and the Audit Committee reviews and recommends them to the Board before CMA filing.

controls.title: Technical accounting review of new transactions and standards
controls.description: Business units notify Financial Reporting of new, unusual or significant transactions (acquisitions, new financing, lease modifications, restructuring) through the transaction review protocol; Financial Reporting prepares an accounting memo with the IFRS analysis, reviewed by the CFO and shared with the external auditor. New and amended IFRS standards are assessed annually for impact and the assessment is presented to the Audit Committee.

controls.title: Audit Committee oversight of financial reporting
controls.description: The Audit Committee, comprising a majority of independent members per CMA Corporate Governance Regulations, meets at least quarterly to review interim and annual financial statements, significant judgements and estimates, external auditor reports, and ICFR deficiencies reported by management and internal audit. Minutes document the matters discussed and conclusions reached.

controls.title: Chart of accounts and GL master data change control
controls.description: Additions and changes to the chart of accounts, cost centres and reporting mappings are requested through a change form, approved by the Financial Reporting Manager and executed by a restricted Finance Systems role; a quarterly report of master data changes is reviewed for unauthorized changes.

controls.title: Sub-ledger to GL interface completeness
controls.description: Automated interfaces from sub-ledgers (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll, inventory) and from operational systems post to the GL with control totals; interface exception and suspense reports are reviewed daily by the GL Accountant and items are cleared before period close.
